| Service | Typical Endpoint | Key Requirements |
|---------|------------------|------------------|
| **OpenWeatherMap** | `https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/onecall?lat=37.8651&lon=-119.5383&exclude=current,minutely,daily,alerts&units=metric&appid=YOUR_API_KEY` | API key |
| **WeatherAPI.com** | `https://api.weatherapi.com/v1/forecast.json?key=YOUR_API_KEY&q=37.8651,-119.5383&days=10&aqi=no&alerts=no` | API key |
| **Met.no (Norwegian Meteorological Institute)** | `https://api.met.no/weatherapi/locationforecast/2.0/compact?lat=37.8651&lon=-119.5383` | No key required, but must include a User-Agent header |

Once you have the JSON response, you can parse the `hourly` array (or equivalent) to extract:

- `temperature` (°C or °F)
- `wind_speed` (m/s or mph)
- `precipitation` (mm or inches)

If you’d like, I can show you a short example of how to call one of these APIs in Python or JavaScript, or help you interpret the returned data. Just let me know!
